lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a multi-row grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank. Clusters are smaller and denser immediately posterior to the gill slits, increasing in size and spacing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a localized grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are discernible along the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light intensity on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a low-luminance, elongated shape consistent with a remora located ventrally to the pectoral fin attachment point.
